body: HARSHA AGM 23-Jul-2026: re-appointment of ID Kunal Shah passed with 14.14% against (11.40 m of 80.61 m). Promoters hold 68.28 m (75%); if they all voted for, non-promoters cast ~12.3 m votes of which ~92% were against [EST; scrutiniser report has no category split]. With 70-75% promoter holdings a special resolution cannot fail, so the headline understates dissent. Rule: in the L5 vote-results table report (a) promoter shares held vs votes polled (L40) and (b) non-promoter dissent = against / (total cast - promoter votes); flag any resolution with non-promoter dissent > 50% and look for proxy-adviser reports.
title: Read minority dissent as against / (votes cast - promoter shares); a 14% headline can be ~92% of the free float that voted

body: VIYASH (dd9): SeQuent (animal health) absorbed Viyash Life Sciences + Symed under common control 11 months before the draw. The symbol's 10-yr EPS/P/E history is a different business; FY25->TTM ROIIC ~52% is a merger window; the PEAD SUE +3.23 (quintile 5) compares merged Q2 FY27 with pre-merger Q2 FY26. Candidate rule: if a scheme changed >50% of revenue in 2 years, mark own-history and PEAD 'not comparable' and use peers + restated pro-forma only.
title: An identity-changing merger in the last 2 years breaks own-history bands, ROIIC windows and PEAD comparators
